description: Transcribe speech to word-level JSON with a THIRD-PARTY engine (ElevenLabs Scribe), not Adobe: an audio or video file is UPLOADED to ElevenLabs (US-hosted; the picture is uploaded too when the source is a video file) and needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; confirm_upload: true is required and nothing is sent without it. Source is one of media_path (an audio or video file; no Premiere call), or a sequence: when its only audible clip is one untouched media file that file is uploaded directly (offset and audible range returned; an .mp4 or .mov is uploaded with its picture), otherwise the active sequence is exported to the workspace first. Without export_preset_path the export uses an audio-only Adobe Media Encoder system preset (WAV, else AAC, MP3 or AIFF, found under the AME install's MediaIO/systempresets and checked to render no video), so only sound is uploaded; export_preset_used names the preset. Only if none is found does it fall back to the H.264 preset, which writes picture and sound, so the picture is uploaded too and a warning says so. The exported file stays in the workspace (named in exported_file_left_in_workspace) unless delete_export_after_upload is true. Writes the engine's raw JSON into approved_workspace_path and returns its path, revision, summary and the offset to give plan_captions. For Adobe's own on-device Speech to Text use prepare_transcript_workflow.

approved_workspace_path.description: Absolute existing directory where the transcript JSON (and, for a sequence export, the exported file) is written.

confirm_upload.description: Must be true. Records that the user agreed to send this audio or video file to ElevenLabs, a third-party service (US-hosted), for transcription (the picture is uploaded too when the source is a video file). Without it nothing is sent.

delete_export_after_upload.description: Sequence export only. Default false: the exported file stays in approved_workspace_path and is named in exported_file_left_in_workspace. true: after a successful transcription delete that exported file (only that file, only when it is inside the workspace and this call created it).

diarize.description: Label who is speaking. Default true.

engine.description: Transcription engine. Only elevenlabs (Scribe) so far.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

export_preset_path.description: Optional absolute .epr preset for the sequence export (sequence sources that cannot use the shortcut). Default: an audio-only Adobe Media Encoder system preset (WAV, AAC, MP3 or AIFF) when one is installed, so only sound is uploaded; if none is found, Premiere's H.264 preset, which writes picture and sound (a warning says so).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-chosen key (1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -) for this intended edit. Pass a fresh key per edit and reuse it only when retrying that same edit, for example after a client-side timeout. A repeat with the same tool, key and arguments is not run again: while the first call is running it fails with IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (poll get_last_operations); after it finished it returns the original outcome marked replayed. A definite failure with nothing applied (receipt outcome not_applied) may be retried with the same key. Reusing a key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Scoped to this MCP session (the stdio server process, or the HTTP server process when Streamable HTTP is stateless per request) and held in memory only (200 keys, 1 hour); it does not survive a restart or reconnect. Read-only invocations are never deduplicated.

include_media_path.description: Include the source media's absolute path in the result for a sequence clip used directly. Default false: media paths are treated as sensitive.

language.description: ISO 639-1 or 639-3 language code. Omit to auto-detect.

media_path.description: Source A: absolute path of an audio or video file (.wav .aif .aiff .mp3 .m4a .aac .flac .ogg .opus .mp4 .mov .webm), at most 1 GB. No Premiere call is made. Give exactly one of media_path, sequence_id or use_active_sequence.

media_shortcut.description: Sequence sources only. Default true: when the sequence's only audible clip is one untouched media file (speed 1, not reversed, enabled, default Volume/Channel Volume/Panner only, Volume Level unkeyed at 0 dB), upload that file directly. false forces an export of the sequence mix.

output_path.description: Optional absolute .json path for the engine's raw response; must be inside approved_workspace_path and must not exist. Default: '<name>.elevenlabs.json' in the workspace, with ' 2', ' 3' added if the name is taken.

sequence_id.description: Source B: exact sequence ID whose audio to transcribe. Exporting it needs it to be the active sequence (call set_active_sequence first).

tag_audio_events.description: Mark laughter, applause and similar as audio events. Default true.

use_active_sequence.description: Source B: transcribe the active sequence instead of naming a sequence_id.

name: transcribe_audio

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

idempotency.description: Present when idempotency_key deduplicated this call: replayed is true when the original outcome was returned instead of running again.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.

title: Transcribe Audio
